newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Mead, Weyerhaeuser, Westvaco started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Mead, Weyerhaeuser, Westvaco started.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers initiated coverage of Mead Corp, Weyerhaeuser Co and Westvaco Corp with neutral ratings, the brokerage house said.

-- In a research report, Lehman analyst James Flicker said the paper companies scored well in a ranking of 19 companies by returns on equity and cost efficiency, which will be available later this week.

-- Mead and Westvaco are among the better-positioned stocks in the paper and forest products universe. Westvaco scored well on both tests and Mead tied for fifth place, he said. Both stocks benefit from non-commodity product profiles.
-- Mead is a major producer of paper and paperboard with its largest exposure to coated grades. Westvaco is a major producer of coated papers, bleached paperboard, and saturating kraft.
-- Weyerhaeuser is better-positioned than competitors to benefit from rising prices for dimensional wood products, Flicker said.
